sessionStart.command: d="${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; { t="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && case "$(git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath)" in .githooks|.githooks/|./.githooks|./.githooks/|"$t/.githooks"|"$t/.githooks/") ;; *) git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath .githooks;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

beforeShellExecution.command: d="${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; { t="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && case "$(git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath)" in .githooks|.githooks/|./.githooks|./.githooks/|"$t/.githooks"|"$t/.githooks/") ;; *) git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath .githooks;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; cat >/dev/null; printf '{"permission":"allow"}\n'
